capabilities: : Convert inline comments to Word comments
: Export multiple notes into one document
intentEvidence: Export inline note comments as native Word comments in a new DOCX file.
problem: Standard Markdown exports leave review notes as plain text within the document body, making them difficult to manage as true comments in Word.

relations.evidence: A Pandoc export leaves them in the body as plain text.
The tab and settings card suggest other NoteMods plugins

summary: Converts inline note comments marked with %% into native Word comments when exporting a note to a DOCX file.
